name: horizontal-scroll
title: 横向滚动区块 Horizontal Scroll
description: 将垂直滚动距离映射为钉住内容轨道的水平移动。

props.name: children
props.description: Wide content translated horizontally while the section is pinned.

props.name: container
props.description: Scrollable element to observe instead of the page.

props.name: scrollPadding
props.description: Extra vertical scrolling distance in pixels.

props.name: viewportClassName
props.description: Classes applied to the pinned viewport.

props.name: trackClassName
props.description: Classes applied to the horizontally translated track.

usage: `HorizontalScroll` 测量轨道溢出宽度，将同等距离加入页面高度，并在区块经过时固定视口、移动内部轨道。它适合案例画廊、时间线和横向章节，不会改变子元素的结构。
